stateFoundationConcentration.note: Non-TMNSN Sihtasutus (foundations) — primarily state innovation agencies (e.g., Enterprise Estonia / KredEx) and public regional hospitals organized as foundations — account for over 80% of nonprofit-form EU/EEA project budgets in Estonia, whereas active tax-incentive MTÜ grassroots charities receive 1.3%. Legal form alone does not distinguish state agencies from charities.

unmatchedRtkNonprofitPrefixCodes.note: RTK project recipients with 8-digit codes starting in 8 or 9 that are not in the active MTÜ/SA/AÜ set are primarily Korteriühistu (apartment associations receiving KredEx building-renovation grants) or previously dissolved entities. They are excluded from the charity/nonprofit funding totals.
